Your plate-pool lives at https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/

Your home kit is saved there under kit `d33b57cc`, so a link like https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/?kit=d33b57cc opens it with your plates already in place. Each of your routines also links straight to the exact bar or dumbbell load for that day, and there's a longer one-off link that sets up the whole home inventory from scratch if you ever need it on a new device — say the word and I'll pull that out for you.
